sections.title: Explanation — Junior Developer Style
sections.body:
### Nested Dict Comprehensions

Just like nested list comprehensions, you can have a **dict comprehension inside another dict comprehension** — or a list comprehension inside a dict comprehension (and vice versa).

```python
# Dict comprehension where VALUE is also a dict comprehension
{
    outer_key: {inner_key: inner_value for ...}   # inner dict
    for ...                                        # outer iteration
}
```

### Most Common Patterns

```python
# Pattern 1: Group by key → list of values
# Pattern 2: Nested data structure from flat data
# Pattern 3: Apply transformation to nested dicts
```
